purpose: Fix, before any world model exists, how a predictive component will be judged in Stage 3G-3I: by the decisions it improves, not by how well it reconstructs the world.
canonicalRule: LOWER FACTUAL PREDICTION LOSS DOES NOT IMPLY BETTER DECISION VALUE.
tournamentRule: No learned world model may win the Stage 3I tournament solely because it has the lowest reconstruction, latent, or next-state prediction loss. Ranking is by DDV on sealed HOLDOUT and OOD, then TCA, then CR; FPE and CAD are reported diagnostics and never decide a ranking on their own.

FPE.name: FACTUAL_PREDICTION_ERROR
FPE.question: How accurately did Sentinel predict what actually happened after the executed action?
FPE.scope: Executed action only, at decision points where a prediction was recorded before execution.
FPE.measurement: Per predicted field: the Stage 3F.6 quality categories (EXACT, APPROXIMATELY_CORRECT, DIRECTIONALLY_CORRECT, WRONG, INCOMPARABLE, UNKNOWN) and a normalised error; aggregated per partition with Wilson intervals. INCOMPARABLE/UNKNOWN are counted, never scored.
guards: prediction must be recorded at decision time and bound to its outcome (no post-decision information)
privileged (simulator-derived) predictions are reported separately and never counted as learned prediction

CAD.name: COUNTERFACTUAL_ACTION_DISCRIMINATION
CAD.question: Can Sentinel distinguish the predicted consequences of available alternative actions?
CAD.scope: Every legal action at decision points with authoritative counterfactual evaluation (oracle used only as ground truth, never as input).
CAD.measurement: Pairwise ordering concordance of predicted action values against authoritative counterfactual values (ties as ties); top-1 hit of the authoritative optimal set; AUROC of optimal versus non-optimal actions. Reported overall and within equal-cost candidate sets (the Stage 3F free-action regime).

CR.name: COUNTERFACTUAL_REGRET
CR.question: How much decision value was lost because Sentinel ranked alternative futures incorrectly?
CR.measurement: Authoritative value of the best action minus that of the action the component ranks first (uniform over tied top ranks): mean, normalised, p95 and catastrophic rate (regret >= STAGE3F6_METHODOLOGY.catastrophicRegret).

DDV.name: DOWNSTREAM_DECISION_VALUE
DDV.question: Did using the predictive component improve Prime's final governed recommendation?
DDV.measurement: Paired ablation on sealed partitions: Prime with versus without the component. Action accuracy, normalised regret, catastrophic rate and false-selection harm, each with a paired 95% bootstrap interval.
DDV.materiality: Inherited Stage 3F bar: accuracy gain >= 0.02 or normalised-regret reduction >= 0.02 with the paired interval beyond zero and no significant worsening of the other; must hold on OOD; nuisance (D4, identity, candidate order) dependence of the increment <= 0.02; false-selection harm within its predeclared bound.

TCA.name: TRUST_CONDITIONED_ADVANTAGE
TCA.question: How much realized decision value is gained specifically on cases admitted by a future World-Model Trust Gate?
TCA.measurement: DDV restricted to cases the (future) World-Model Trust Gate admits, reported with admission coverage, plus the coverage-weighted advantage and the harm on admitted cases. Gate thresholds are frozen on CAL before any sealed exposure.

evaluationDiscipline: DEV fit, CAL selection, sealed HOLDOUT/OOD confirmation, predeclared before sealed exposure
D4, identity-permutation and candidate-order nuisance audits on every headline number (Stage 3F shortcut lesson)
deployable versus privileged versus oracle provenance declared for every input and prediction
accuracy and regret always reported separately
computed under SENTINEL_CANONICAL_NUMERICS_V1 and verified read-only (Stage 3F-RP)
